description: A Python script implementing a bot that uses a pipeline to process text-to-speech streaming via various transport mechanisms, configured with environment variables and supporting a client connection event.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a speech processing task within the pipeline, configured with specific frames.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Sequential processing unit aggregating multiple stages such as TTS and transport output.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and management of a pipeline, including signal handling.

classes.name: RimeHttpTTSService
classes.description: A service class responsible for text-to-speech conversion via RIME API over HTTP.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms handling client communication.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters specific to Daily transport.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up a pipeline with TTS and transport, and runs it asynchronously.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point initializing the transport and starting the bot pipeline.
